title: User Profile
description: Structured profile produced by the intake flow. The AI's only job is parsing free text into these fields with a confidence per field; nothing here decides a recommendation. Persisted as an immutable row in profile_versions — every edit writes a new version, so a decision record can foreign-key the exact profile that produced it.

sex.questionnaireText: What is your sex? (used for nutrient requirement differences, e.g. iron)

bodyWeightKg.questionnaireText: What is your current body weight, in kilograms?
bodyWeightKg.notes: ADDED v3. Required. Protein targets are g/kg/day and creatine loading is weight-scaled — without this, no dose computes at all. If the user declines, the engine must escalate or fall back to an absolute target, never guess.

heightCm.notes: Not used by any MVP rule. Collected for future energy-requirement estimation.

monthlyBudgetINR.questionnaireText: Roughly what would you be comfortable spending on supplements per month, in rupees? (optional — leave blank for no limit)
monthlyBudgetINR.notes: ADDED v3. Consumed ONLY by the budget allocator, which runs after the recommendation set is fixed. The rules engine must never read this field — validate.mjs enforces that by rejecting any eligibility or dosing predicate that references it.

budgetIsHardConstraint.questionnaireText: Should we stay strictly within that, or show slightly over-budget options too?
budgetIsHardConstraint.notes: False lets the allocator show the next item over budget as a near-miss rather than deferring it silently.

isPregnantOrBreastfeeding.questionnaireText: Are you currently pregnant or breastfeeding?
isPregnantOrBreastfeeding.notes: Hard global escalation trigger. Only asked when sex = female; defaults to false otherwise.

dietaryPattern.notes: Matched against each ingredient's suitableFor to drive substitution.

exerciseFrequencyPerWeek.questionnaireText: How many days a week do you exercise?

exerciseIntensityTypical.questionnaireText: On a typical session, how intense is your exercise?
exerciseIntensityTypical.notes: ADDED 2026-09-06. Additive alongside exerciseFrequencyPerWeek/exerciseType — how hard, not how often or what kind. Not yet read by any eligibility/dosing/safety policy; collected for whoever next authors a policy that could use it (beta-alanine/caffeine relevance is really about intensity).

primaryGoals.questionnaireText: What are you mainly trying to achieve right now? (up to 3)
primaryGoals.notes: Order matters: index 0 is the primary goal and scores 2 in goal_alignment; the rest score 1. Mapped to physiological outcomes via entities/goals.json so that adding a goal is one row, not an edit to every ingredient.

sleepHoursTypical.questionnaireText: On a typical night, how many hours do you sleep?

existingSupplementUse.questionnaireText: Are you taking any supplements now? List them.
existingSupplementUse.notes: Free text normalised by the AI layer to compound ids using compounds.json aliases. Feeds both the duplicate suppression and the dose ledger — anything already being taken counts towards the UL.

dietaryProteinAdequacy.questionnaireText: Do you feel you consistently get enough protein from food?
dietaryProteinAdequacy.notes: Rough self-assessment, not a diet log. 'unsure' evaluates to unknown in three-valued logic, which fails closed to not recommending.

estimatedDailyProteinG.questionnaireText: About how many grams of protein a day do you get from food?
estimatedDailyProteinG.notes: CHANGED 2026-09-06: now asked as a required slider in the intake form (with a food-reference panel to help estimate), not an optional follow-up. Leaving this unset previously made resolveDosing() fall back to the FULL target instead of a real gap, which is why protein was showing 4-5 scoops/day for most people — see lib/engine/dosing.ts. Stays optional in this schema (not every profile source is the intake form) but the form itself no longer allows skipping it.

dietaryOilyFishServingsPerWeek.questionnaireText: How many servings of oily fish do you eat per week?
dietaryOilyFishServingsPerWeek.notes: CHANGED 2026-09-06: required in the intake form (was optional) — lib/engine/dosing.ts now converts this into an estimated daily EPA+DHA mg amount (a deliberately conservative average per serving) so omega-3's gap can be quantified the same way protein's is, instead of always falling back to the full target.

relevantHealthContext.questionnaireText: Anything else about your health or lifestyle we should know? (optional)

hasAny.questionnaireText: Are you taking any prescription medication, or do you have a diagnosed condition?

parseConfidence.notes: Set by the AI parser. Below the threshold, the safety gate treats the field as unknown — which, under onUnknown: true, escalates. This is the mechanism that stops an unparseable medication list from being silently skipped.

medicationsOrConditionsFlag.notes: hasAny = true is never an escalate-everything switch. It is checked ingredient by ingredient against safety policy.

fieldConfidence.description: Per-field parse confidence from the LLM intake step. Fields below threshold must be confirmed by the user before the profile version is written.
